name: fireworks
summary: Successfully made a chat completion API call to Fireworks and received a response: "Hello in Spanish is **Hola**." Used the OpenAI SDK approach from the quickstart docs. The FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable was already available in the sandbox.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I queried the available models endpoint and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2", which worked and returned a chat completion.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}...}

friction.detail: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error.
model = "accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-70b-instruct" also produced openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404...
Had to manually query available models via curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models to find a working ID.
